thesis: VTRS is in a clean uptrend (close 20.82 above SMA20 19.27, SMA50 18.11 and SMA200 16.10, rs_63 +36%) in a sector the risk-off regime favors, and the Q3 EPS beat with guidance held plus a forward P/E of 7.59 support it. Reward/risk from the mid-zone entry of 20.575 is about 2.1, but it falls to about 1.41 at the 20.82 last close and about 1.19 at the 20.93 pre-market print. RSI 70, the close 8% above the SMA20, the price at the 21.3 mean analyst target and the stall after the 11/12 reversal from 21.20 cap the near-term edge. Rated Hold under provisional lesson 1 (downgrade when reward/risk at the last price is below 1.5); revisit as Overweight if price trades into the 20.35-20.80 zone and holds above 19.90.
invalidation: A daily close below 19.90 (the 11/09 low) invalidates the setup, and a close under the 20-day SMA (~19.27) confirms the breakout failed.
